source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Whenever a barbed ovipositor attack from this model destroys an **INFANTRY** model, you can add 1 new **RIPPER SWARMS** unit of D3 models to your army after this model finishes its attacks. If you do:

- set the new unit up no more than 3" from this model
- it may be set up in **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of the unit the **destroyed** model belonged to, but not of any other enemy unit

detail.trigger: barbed ovipositor attack destroys an INFANTRY model
detail.timing: after this model has finished making its attacks
